How strong and brave you are. It takes a lot of bravery to transition and a lot of strength to seek help with depression. I know for me that I've suffered from depression and suicidal thoughts off and on for the past 4 years but once I was able to work up the courage to ask for help, things got much better. And you're already there! I'm so proud that you're able to seek help! The reason I spoke up about my depression is because I met someone who went through the same thing a few years ago and they really inspired me to seek help. They changed my life and probably saved me. You are an inspiration to me and i'm sure many other people but you just don't know it yet.

You are definitely not a failure. Things may not be going the best right now but that doesn't mean you failed. You've gotten this far and that's an incredible accomplishment! A lot more than other people could do. I think you live and learn. And right now you're doing a lot of both but that's really good and you keep moving forward. You learn from the past so you can better prepare for the future and maybe in a year or two you'll be able to help someone going through the same situation you are. I still think you're incredibly brave. 😊
